sources.title: Gemma 3: Google’s new open model based on Gemini 2.0
sources.snippet: Gemma 3 is a collection of lightweight, state-of-the-art open models designed to run on devices. Gemma 3 outperforms other models in its size class, making it ideal for single-GPU or TPU applications. Gemma 3 supports over 140 languages and offers advanced text and visual reasoning capabilities.
